validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a" datamodel="ecmascript">
  <state id="a">
    <invoke type="scxml" src="child.scxml" srcexpr="'child.scxml'"><content><scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0"><final id="f"/></scxml></content></invoke>
    <transition event="done.invoke" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: invoke declares three sources: `src`, `srcexpr`, and inline `<content>`
notes: `src`/`srcexpr`, `type`/`typeexpr`, `id`/`idlocation`, and an external source versus inline `<content>` are each mutually exclusive ways to say what to invoke and how to identify it
